definitions.content:
Bull. 2518, Evaporation Loss from Fixed-Roof Tanks, 1962 This bulletin contains the correlation and evaluation of test data from companies with evaporation loss from fixed-roof tanks. The information has been used to develop methods of estimating breathing and working losses from gasoline and crude oil tanks. Also included are a loss calculation summary and sample calculations. 38 pages.

Price each, $7.00
